description: A transcript whose two user messages share the id u1, with distinct text, and an entry_patch record for u1 between them. Every reader of a session file sets a record's fields on the last entry with the id it names: `reads` is the text of each u1 message, in file order, as every reader reads it. Read by crates/natives/src/transcripts.rs, packages/utils/test/entry-patches.test.ts, packages/stats/test/entry-patches.test.ts, packages/coding-agent/test/session/entry-patch-projections.test.ts and scripts/session-stats/test_sync.py.
